7.1.16 Restricted OS functionality access
To avoid too much complexity in the OS integration of BSW Modules, some restrictions
in the usage of OS services are necessary.
[SWS_BSW_00138] Restriction to usage of OS services
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00429
